definitions.explanation: The beneficial effect or power that something has, especially regarding medicine, hot springs, food, or other health-related substances. Often seen on product labels and at hot spring facilities.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{効能|こうのう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{効能|こうのう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{書|か}かれた→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦{看板|かんばん}→看板：00166_kanban⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a sign listing the health benefits of the hot spring.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{疲労|ひろう}→疲労：13603_hirou⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{効能|こうのう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: This tea is said to have the beneficial effect of relieving fatigue.

notes:
Frequently seen on hot spring (⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧) signs listing health benefits, and on medicine and supplement labels. More formal than ⟦{効|き}き{目|め}→効き目：19884_kikime⟧ (effectiveness in everyday speech).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {効能|こうのう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have efficacy/benefits)
- ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{効能|こうのう} (efficacy of medicine)
- ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{効能|こうのう} (health benefits of a hot spring)
- {効能|こうのう}⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ (statement of efficacy)
